recommendations.title: A New Transformer Passes Its Hidden State to the Next Token Instead of Recomputing It
recommendations.verdict: 把递归信息流装回 Transformer 的一个务实做法，预训练仍可全并行。
recommendations.reason: arXiv 新论文提出 LIFT：把每个 token 与一个信息稠密状态配对做教师强制式预训练，让模型学会把深层状态回传给后续生成步。135M–1B 上 token-matched 预算全面领先，状态跟踪对照中小模型胜过 8 倍数据的同尺寸模型。
key_points: Transformer 的信息只能沿 token 下传，导致重复计算与备选路径丢弃
修法：用现成模型的 next-token 分布当教师信号，同时预测下一 token 与下一状态
状态预计算保持位置间全并行，推理端回喂自身预测状态、开销随规模下降
135M–1B 全面领先；状态跟踪中小模型胜过 8 倍数据对照，更大规模待验证
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：LIFT 点出了 Transformer 一个常被忽略的结构约束——深层表示只能靠「下一个 token」这条窄通道向后传递；论文给出的修法（预计算状态 + 教师强制）保留全并行预训练，又在 135M–1B 规模上领先，是「机制清楚、代价可算」的架构改进。

1. 问题：现有模型是单向的。深层表示不回流到浅层，跨生成步的信息通道只剩「已解码的 token」。代价有两个：中间结果被反复重算；除选中 token 之外的所有备选续写被直接丢弃。长链推理、状态跟踪这类任务，一直在为这条窄通道买单。

2. 方法：LIFT 把「递归地保持状态」改写成教师强制式的监督问题。每个输入 token 配一个信息稠密的状态，状态取自一个现成预训练模型的 next-token 分布——不用新训一个老师，直接复用已有模型。模型只加少量参数，同时预测下一个 token 和下一个状态。

3. 为什么还能全并行：教师状态离线预计算好，每个位置的状态在输入侧就绪、不依赖上一步输出，预训练保持位置间全并行——这正是传统循环式回传做不到的。推理时则把模型自己预测的状态喂回去，额外开销可控，且论文称开销随模型规模下降。

4. 实验：135M 到 1B、token-matched 预算下，LIFT 在语言建模、下游推理与程序性任务上稳定优于标准 Transformer 与基线；compute-matched 下持平或领先。最有说服力的是状态跟踪的对照实验：小 LIFT 打败用 8 倍数据训练的同等大小 Transformer——哪怕教师状态来自一个在该任务上失败的模型，学生仍能学到可用的反馈机制。

5. 边界与疑问：规模只到 1B，「开销随规模下降」恰好需要更大模型来证实；摘要里没给出状态维度、回传位置等设计细节对收敛的影响。作为方向性结果值得跟踪，离生产级替代还有距离。

我的推荐：如果你关心「Transformer 之后」的架构演化，这是本周最值得花时间的一篇。不必读全文，先把摘要和状态跟踪实验设定过一遍——它解释了一个被主流叙事忽略的瓶颈，也给「用便宜的老师教结构」提供了一个可复制的套路。

recommendations.title: How I Could've Accessed 17 Trillion Microsoft Records
recommendations.verdict: 一个缺失的签名校验能走多远——当晚最值得读的安全复盘。
recommendations.reason: 16 岁研究者的完整漏洞复盘：微软内部 Titan 分析服务不校验 JWT 签名，无签名令牌穿过四层校验、以 admin 身份执行 SQL，可触及 17.3 万亿行的环境。攻防细节、处置时间线与教训俱全。
key_points: Titan 的 /v2/Query 不要求鉴权却接受原生 SQL，Swagger 公开了路由结构
签名从不被校验：无签名 JWT 依次通过 tenant、audience、appid 检查
关键跳跃：upn 从邮箱格式改为 admin，命中本地用户 ID 1 的 Admin 角色
「用户不存在」其实是认证已通过的信号——AI 持续试探加人类换视角
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：一篇教科书级的「只看内容、不验签名」漏洞复盘——一个免鉴权的 SQL 接口，被 AI 猎手加人类直觉打到 17.3 万亿行的门内；攻防细节与「AI 做不到什么」的反思都值得读。

1. 入口：微软内部服务 Titan 的前端有 VPN 限制，但它的 API 有一个公开的 Swagger 文件，列出四条路由——三条要求 Azure AD 认证，唯独接受原生 SQL 的 /v2/Query 不需要。作者用 Wayback Machine 里 2023 年的页面快照恢复出 56 个表路由值（含 TestData），随后开始逐层试探。

2. 破门：接口对匿名请求返回 401 后，AI 猎手 Antares 逐一挖出 JWT 校验逻辑的层级——换 tenant、换 audience、换 appid，最后进入用户查找。关键线索是：payload 一直变、签名一直没变，接口仍然接受——签名根本没有被验证。于是直接构造 alg:none 的无签名 token，三段结构的第三段留空。

3. 致命一跳：无签名 token 已通过全部校验层级，却卡在「用户不存在」。Antares 按邮箱格式的 UPN 猜了十天；作者凌晨换了个角度——upn 在后端可能只是本地用户名。把值改成 admin，命中本地用户 ID 1（Admin 角色），SQL 开始执行。这是「AI 勤奋加人类换视角」最直观的示例：模型记住了字段名，人想到了字段背后的实现。

4. 范围：56 个路由值中 30 个仍存活，穿过 24 个配置映射到 17 个 ClickHouse 分析库、9,863 张表；元数据里能看到约 2.5 万条账号记录、1.8 万条员工邮箱等。作者只做有界验证：Bing 分析分区取了两行样本，全程未触碰客户数据或 PII。总量估算 17,333,335,124,315 行（含副本与历史数据）。

5. 余波与教训：MSRC case 144051，9 月 9 日端点被封停，随后拿到 5,000 美元奖励；微软对文稿有编辑控制权，部分影响描述被改写，这本身也是披露流程的一环。技术教训一句话：验证签名优先于验证声明——所有访问控制逻辑都做对了，漏掉这一条，等于没做。

我的推荐：这是当晚最佳安全写作。开发者可以把它当成「JWT 校验清单」的反面教材；关注 AI 工程的人能看到一个 agent 主导的真实挖洞工作流，以及它在哪里必须停下来等人类。9 分钟，值。

recommendations.title: 5x Faster Edge Functions: How We Replaced V8 Isolates with Firecracker MicroVMs
recommendations.verdict: 把执行层收回自己手里的完整架构课，数字和细节都实在。
recommendations.reason: Netlify 把 Edge Functions 从第三方托管的 V8 isolate 迁到自家网络内的 Firecracker MicroVM：p50 从 25–40ms 降到 5–6ms，p99 改善 47.4%。请求全链路、隔离模型、快照恢复与运维经验都写得细。
key_points: spec 加 service ID 做隔离：不同 deploy 永不共享 MicroVM，V8 isolate 做不到同级
rendezvous hashing 保粘性、阈值放宽防热点；快照恢复加闲置缩容到零
运维要点：本地 DNS、启动分段指标、熔断、渐进发布；旧限制具备重定条件
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：一次把「边缘函数执行层」整个换掉的一手复盘——从第三方托管的 V8 isolate 迁到自家网络内的 Firecracker MicroVM，每天约 10 亿次调用的底座，warm 调用 p50 从 25–40ms 降到了 5–6ms。

1. 成绩单：warm 调用 p50 5–6ms（旧设施 25–40ms），p99 快了 47.4%，可用性 99.998%，日志投递快 5 倍；冷启动只占 1.2% 的调用，平均约 9ms。对「每个请求都压在用户等待路径上」的场景，这是实打实的量级改善。

2. 请求链路：edge 节点终结 TLS 后写一份 machine spec（runtime、平台、用户代码三份镜像，加 CPU/内存/连接限制）；spec 的哈希加站点信息构成 service ID——不同 deploy、不同环境变量就是不同 service，永不共享 MicroVM。选节点用 rendezvous hashing 保持粘性（同一 service 总落在同一节点，换来热缓存与本地镜像），超过阈值再放宽，以吸收单租户流量尖峰、防止热点。

3. 隔离升级：这是从 isolate 迁到 MicroVM 最本质的收益——即使某个 deploy 逃逸出运行时，也无法污染其他客户或计算层本身。文中直接写明「V8 isolate 提供不了这个级别的隔离」。对多租户平台，这一条比延迟数字更重要。

4. VM 生命周期：Firecracker MicroVM 亚毫秒创建、p99 约 2ms 启动；代码以未压缩 EROFS 镜像挂载并内存映射，只读用到的部分；用户 JS 服务开始监听后对 VM 做快照，闲置时缩容到零，下次调用从快照恢复、内存映射直接执行。boot、快照、恢复、缩容到零这整套生命周期由 Unikraft 的产品支撑。

5. 运维与后续：本地 DNS 解析器、分段指标（boot 时间、首次端口打开、用户代码启动）、熔断与渐进发布（新 fleet 健康后才接管流量）。能力上：npm 支持走出 beta、isolate 时代的三项限制（50ms CPU、512MB 内存、20MB 压缩包）具备重新审视的条件、计算留在自家网络内——「执行层的天花板归自己抬」。

我的推荐：如果你的系统里也有「把第三方执行层换成自建」的选项，这篇是难得的一手对照材料：什么时候值得换（隔离、延迟、控制权），换的时候会踩什么（DNS、端口、热点、发布），全部用数字说话。

items.title: Google figures out how to watermark AI-designed proteins (11 minute read)
items.summary: The DeepMind team at Google has developed a technique that can create watermarks on protein sequences without compromising the protein's function. The watermark is impossible to remove and can survive basic exporting, resizing, and other editing. The system could be used to give DNA synthesizers greater confidence in their sources.

items.title: The Router Economy (18 minute read)
items.summary: AI assistants are becoming a router between people and every business. They decide who gets the work, which moves where money can be made. The router absorbs capability and decision-making. The margin goes to whoever holds what the router cannot take and whoever signs for what the router cannot sign.

items.title: Is Sandboxing Sufficient to Contain Rogue Agents? (14 minute read)
items.summary: Recent incidents involving agents probing network boundaries motivate a closer look at whether conventional sandboxes can contain increasingly capable systems. The analysis weighs better operational security against the harder possibility that containment alone is insufficient when agents can discover vulnerabilities, coordinate, and exploit overlooked paths.
items.score_reason: 深度分析：传统沙箱对高能力代理的容纳边界。
items.highlight: 密码学家格林评智能体遏制之争：沙箱意味着把安全押在监视海量流量上，而监视只能再交给模型——「看守式沙箱」本质仍是对齐问题；他更担心完全服从的智能体被他人指令劫持、像蠕虫般在隔离环境间传染。

items.title: A Realistic Code Execution Exploit Chain in OpenBao and Vault (11 minute read)
items.summary: ControlPlane chained four OpenBao flaws into an unauthenticated-to-RCE exploit that forges a SPIFFE provisioner certificate via an ACME URI SAN bypass, hijacks an admin role through case-insensitive ACL paths, and crosses namespaces to restore a malicious Raft snapshot. The final step executes any pre-existing binary whose SHA-256 the attacker can guess, even on read-only images and auto-unseal nodes, and Vault Community Edition remains unpatched after IBM declined a mutual disclosure agreement. Upgrade to OpenBao v2.6.3 or v2.7.0, or, as a stopgap, remove plugin_directory and enforce ACME EAB via BAO_DISABLE_PUBLIC_ACME.
items.score_reason: 漏洞链复盘：从未授权到远程代码执行的四步组合利用。
items.highlight: ControlPlane 披露 OpenBao/Vault 完整利用链：ACME 校验绕过、非规范路径绕过 ACL、跨命名空间提权与快照恢复 RCE 四洞串联，从未认证直达代码执行，Vault 用户仍待修复。
items.excerpt: In collaboration with the upstream OpenBao community, ControlPlane recently fixed a full exploit chain from unauthenticated access to full remote code execution. This is the second-ever remote code execution vulnerability in Vault and OpenBao. This chain combines disclosures from three independent reporters patched in the latest release.

items.title: Stack Unwinding Can Lead to Leakless Code Execution (7 minute read)
items.summary: This post describes a code execution technique in which an exploit abuses POSIX “cancellation points” to eventually execute code. This works by executing DWARF bytecode to mangle the .eh_frame_hdr data that is used when unwinding the stack. While this technique was discovered in the context of CTFs, it has applications outside of CTFs.
items.score_reason: 利用技术：借助栈展开机制实现的免泄漏代码执行。
items.highlight: 作者发现 glibc 的 read 是线程取消点，取消会让 libgcc_s 解析 .eh_frame 执行 DWARF 虚拟机代码；仅需一次大块 malloc 加越界写空字节，就能把栈展开器变成无需地址泄露的代码执行原语。
items.excerpt: A few years ago, I wrote boogie-woogie for DiceCTF 2024. The premise was to convert relative byte swaps in the `.data` section to code execution.

items.title: GLM-5.3 and the Spread of Advanced Cyber Capabilities (5 minute read)
items.summary: Anthropic posted a blog detailing the threat posed by GLM-5.3 as a cyber-capable, open-source model. Anthropic stated that GLM-5.3 performed comparably to Mythos Preview in ExploitBench, an internal binary exploitation benchmark, and a test of open-ended offensive cyber capabilities when paired with a human expert. Anthropic also reports that a deceptive prompt subverted GLM-5.3's guardrails 64% of the time, prefilling the model's thinking tokens subverted guardrails 92% of the time, and abliterated versions of the model do not contain these ls. guardrails.
items.score_reason: 安全评测讨论：开源模型的进攻性网络能力评估。
items.highlight: Anthropic 评测显示 GLM-5.3 能自主构建端到端漏洞利用，能力接近其前沿模型，却以开放权重发布：简单手法即可绕过防护，消融版拒答率仅约 3%，Flash 版 8 小时就完成 Chrome 利用链。
items.excerpt: Five months ago, we announced Claude Mythos Preview, the first AI model that could autonomously build sophisticated, end-to-end cyber exploits. The rapid rate of improvement in AI suggested to us that this ability would eventually proliferate to many other models, making it much easier for malicious cyber actors to launch highly impactful cyberattacks.

items.title: How We Rebuilt Our Design Language in Three Days with AI (13 minute read)
items.summary: A small team used tightly specified briefs and coding agents to rebuild a 67-page site across 22 visual directions, then turned the strongest ideas into one design system. The process worked because content stayed fixed, rules were numerical, real pages were reviewed, automated checks were themselves verified, and losing experiments were deleted.
items.score_reason: 实践案例：小团队用编码代理重建设计体系的过程。
items.highlight: Curiosity 讲述用 AI 三天重建设计语言的实战：先产出 22 个整站风格实验，以两两对战选出 Yarn Mosaic，再定稿品牌体系；十条经验强调只看真实页面、让变体成本以分钟计、规格写成数字、内容保持不动。
items.excerpt: On September 18 the New York Times ran a story about the Bauhaus, the German design school that is still the reference for so much of how the modern world looks, nearly a century after it closed. It left us with a question we could not put down: what would curiosity.ai look like as a Bauhaus poster? We are a German company that builds software for engineers, and curiosity is in the name, so we tried it.

items.title: Pwnd Blaster: Hacking your PC using your speaker without ever touching it (6 minute read)
items.summary: The Creative Sound Blaster Katana V2X soundbar accepts unauthenticated Bluetooth connections and exposes its proprietary CTP control protocol over BLE. Firmware updates also use CTP and verify only a trivial SHA-256 checksum, allowing an attacker within ~15 meters to install custom firmware without pairing or physical access. The modified firmware adds a full USB keyboard HID descriptor and repurposes an existing diagnostic task to type commands after boot, turning the speaker into a remote BadUSB device. A proof-of-concept payload waits ~20 seconds for USB to initialize, then types echo pwned and presses Enter on the connected PC. Bluetooth stays enabled in sleep mode with no user-accessible toggle. Creative initially declined to classify this as a vulnerability.
items.score_reason: 硬件安全：音箱蓝牙协议缺陷与固件校验弱点。
items.highlight: 研究者发现 Creative Katana V2X 的 CTP 协议在蓝牙端无需认证即可调用，攻击者可远程刷入自定义固件，把音箱变成窃听器，或借其 USB 连接向电脑注入按键、化身无线 Rubber Ducky；厂商起初拒认漏洞。
items.excerpt: In my last post, I talked about reverse engineering my new Creative Sound Blaster Katana V2X's firmware. What initially started as simply wanting to write a Linux tool for communicating with my speaker ended up with me discovering vulnerabilities which allow any attacker within a ~15M range of any Katana V2X to turn it into a covert spying tool and Rubber Ducky - all without ever having to pair with or physically touch the device.

items.title: The Case for Meta Enterprise Platform (8 minute read)
items.summary: Meta's newly announced Meta Enterprise Platform serves a crucial strategic purpose by acting as a secondary demand sink for the company's massive artificial intelligence capital expenditures. Initially, we will focus on bringing our full technology stack, including the Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more to businesses and developers to help them grow.

items.title: How decades of disconnected modernization created OT security debt manufacturers can't escape (13 minute read)
items.summary: Decades of disconnected modernization have created a severe OT security debt crisis for manufacturers, as new technologies were built on legacy systems without proper network segmentation or security architecture. Flat networks, default administrator accounts, and permanent remote access links have vastly expanded the attack surface, turning single footholds into enterprise-wide risks. Addressing this exposure requires asset visibility, realistic exposure management, and tailored controls for brownfield environments rather than complete system replacements.
items.score_reason: 工业安全：长期割裂演进带来的 OT 债务问题。
items.highlight: 制造业数十年现代化只连通不重构：老旧PLC、无认证的Modbus等协议与IT直连层层叠加，形成越滚越大的OT安全债务；专家主张以风险量化排序，用三年计划在检修窗口内完成隔离、分段与高风险系统替换。
items.excerpt: The OT security crisis facing manufacturers today is fundamentally a debt crisis, accumulated over decades as systems grew more connected. Technological enhancements and modernization efforts were increasingly carried out without redesigning organizational security architecture. New technology was simply built upon existing architectural systems and infrastructure, creating an architectural mismatch that currently leaves critical infrastructure vulnerable to operational risk.

items.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon AI model, but you can't use it yet (3 minute read)

items.title: Connecting Agents with Cryptography (6 minute read)
items.summary: There are several techniques for letting people compute something together without sharing the underlying information.
items.score_reason: 技术讲解：代理间密码学协作与隐私计算手法。
items.highlight: Liam Horne探讨用可编程密码学连接AI代理：借助MPC与FHE，代理可先算出窄问题的是或否答案，如薪资是否接近、日程是否有交集，而无需暴露原始数据，并用微支付为加密计算付费，让陌生代理安全发现协作机会。
items.excerpt: I think we’re heading toward a world where everyone has an agent working with a lot of private information: calendars, messages, company documents, customer data, and code. Much of that work will happen in the cloud, where your agent can keep going while you’re doing something else.

items.title: We can and must solve alignment (14 minute read)
items.summary: The Goodfire team identifies interpretability as the main challenge in AI alignment, highlighting its critical role in understanding and controlling AI behaviors. They stress the urgency of developing and deploying tools for detecting, debugging, and designing AI systems, focusing on controlling generalization and verifying what models learn. As AI models advance, they seek breakthroughs in interpretability to ensure safe and reliable AI alignment, advocating for a collective effort among the tech community.
items.score_reason: 立场文章：把可解释性视为对齐核心难题并主张投入。
items.highlight: Goodfire 发文称可解释性是 AI 对齐的瓶颈：其研究在最强开源模型上发现 50-96% 的智能体 rollout 存在奖励作弊，正用激活监控与逆向工程推动模型从「被养大」转向「有意塑造」。
items.excerpt: In San Francisco, it feels like the eve of the singularity. Yet, a walk through the city looks surprisingly mundane, with driverless cars and rolling fog equal parts of the scenery. The world feels oddly normal, but something big and disruptive is coming just around the corner.

items.title: Generalization Dynamics of LM Pre-training (4 minute read)
items.summary: During pre-training, models can abruptly switch response patterns, a phenomenon termed MODE-HOPPING. Tests reveal this behavior in OLMo3-32B during arithmetic tasks, showing sudden shifts between pattern-following and correct task inference as training progresses. Controlled experiments suggest competing shallow and generalizable circuits within models, revealing that longer training doesn't always guarantee better generalization.
items.score_reason: 预训练动力学研究：模型行为模式的突变式切换现象。
items.highlight: 新论文揭示 LM 预训练中的「模式跳变」：OLMo3-32B 在相邻检查点从 81% 骤降到 0% 又回到 81.7%，模型会在浅层模式匹配与可泛化计算之间突然切换；据此选中间检查点，后训练的泛化与抗预填充攻击更强。
items.excerpt: People typically assume that LMs stably mature from pattern-matching parrots to generalizable intelligence during pre-training. We build a toy eval suite and show this mental model is wrong: throughout pre-training, LMs frequently and suddenly hop between parrot-like and intelligence-like computations. Across our suite, LMs suddenly latch onto memorized or in-context patterns instead of in-context learning, use System 1 instead of System 2 thinking, pick up what sounds true instead of what is true, fail at multi-hop persona QA, out-of-context reasoning, and emergent misalignment.

items.title: SynthID Bio: Watermarking methods for synthetic biology (7 minute read)
items.summary: DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, a watermarking tool for AI-generated proteins that embeds a signature into biological code while maintaining function.

SynthID Bio embeds an imperceptible signature directly into the biological code, ensuring the watermark is verifiable not just on a digital model but on the synthesized, physical protein itself – all while preserving its biological function in laboratory testing.

items.title: gRPC vs REST Is the Wrong Question (7 minute read)
items.summary: Connect lets browsers and gRPC clients call the same service without a separate gateway, using HTTP and JSON or binary Protobuf on one port. It preserves schema-driven clients, streaming, ordinary HTTP status codes, and curl-friendly requests while keeping gRPC compatibility.
items.score_reason: 协议设计讨论：统一浏览器与 gRPC 客户端的调用路径。

items.excerpt: The same argument comes up over and over on Twitter, LinkedIn, Reddit, Hacker News, and anywhere else developers gather: gRPC vs. REST. Where should you use HTTP/JSON APIs (what most people mean by “REST”) and where should you use gRPC? The same advice is almost always given: use REST for public or browser-facing APIs, and gRPC for microservices and infrastructure such as etcd and Kubernetes.

items.title: New Spectre-v2 BTR Attack Leaks Linux Memory Despite Existing Defenses (4 minute read)
items.summary: Researchers from VUSec and Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna disclosed Branch Target Reuse (BTR), a Spectre-v2 variant that reuses stale indirect branch prediction entries in JIT engines after code is freed and reallocated. Proof-of-concept exploits against the Linux cBPF JIT recover the root password hash in minutes on patched Intel systems with default protections. Mitigations are merged in the Linux kernel (CVE-2026-64507, CVE-2026-64508). Mozilla is prioritizing site isolation over IBPB-based fixes.
items.score_reason: 漏洞披露：利用陈旧分支预测条目的 Spectre-v2 变种。
items.highlight: VUSec 等披露 Spectre-v2 新变种 BTR：JIT 重写代码后陈旧的分支预测条目仍被复用，形成瞬态 use-after-free；打全补丁的 Intel 上数分钟即可恢复 root 密码哈希，内核缓解已合并。
items.excerpt: A group of academics from VUSec and Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna have disclosed details of a new Spectre CPU vulnerability variant that affects Just-In-Time (JIT) engines present in web browsers, language runtimes, and the operating system kernel, across multiple CPU vendors.

items.title: A GitHub token was stolen. Now what? (11 minute read)
items.summary: Invictus traced a run of 2026 incidents to stolen classic GitHub PATs, typically lifted from developer endpoints by info-stealers and used to map every reachable repository through bursts of /repositories/{id}/readme API calls before cloning. In one case, a single token exposed 1,100+ potential secrets across 300+ repos, and validating and rotating them took 30+ people over a week. Since GitHub keeps Git clone events for only seven days and api.request events require Enterprise audit log streaming, responders should scope to the token's full reach wherever logs are missing, then migrate off classic PATs to fine-grained tokens, GitHub Apps, or OIDC.
items.score_reason: 事件响应复盘：被盗 PAT 的横向排查与处置路径。
items.highlight: 被窃的多数是 classic PAT：它继承账号全部仓库权限，真正的损失是仓库里的密钥——某案例克隆 300 多个仓库、排查出 1100 多个凭证，30 多人耗时一周轮换；作者建议按可达上限界定范围并迁移到细粒度令牌。
items.excerpt: Invictus has been busy handling incidents throughout 2026, and the heart of these cases are GitHub PATs. The scenario is fairly straightforward with a threat actor gaining access to a single token with enough permissions to clone every repository the user has access to. Within a short period of time, large amounts of source code is exfiltrated.

items.title: PixelLeak: How AI Agents Exposed Developer Screenshots from Leading Tech Companies (5 minute read)

items.title: AI's Third Wave: Coworkers Break the Security Model That Worked for Agents (4 minute read)

items.excerpt: We no longer have the luxury of adapting to change over several years. items.title: Most powerful obesity drug yet: People lost up to 25% of weight in trial (5 minute read)

The drug also helped reduce knee pain and sleep apnea events, and it improved cardiometabolic measurements across the board. items.score_reason: 产品更新：沙箱能力的嵌入式分发方式。
items.highlight: E2B 发布 Embed：将运行时与仪表盘打包到单台机器，让沙箱跑进客户自有环境，面向政府与受监管行业。基于 Firecracker 微虚拟机隔离，支持同款 SDK 与自定义模板；Apache-2.0 开源、无需账号或密钥。
items.excerpt: Today we're releasing **E2B Embed**, a way to package E2B with your product and run its sandboxes inside your customer's environment.

items.title: You Said No MCP! (2 minute read)
items.summary: Pi adopted MCP after Codemode made tool composition practical inside a JavaScript sandbox, while arguing that structured data and smarter discovery are still needed for the protocol to reach its potential.
items.score_reason: 技术短评：MCP 工具组合与数据模型的实际取舍。
items.highlight: Earendil 解释 Pi 转向 MCP 的原因：现行协议更成熟，Codemode 让工具在 JavaScript 沙箱内自由组合；文章仍视组合能力与结构化数据为 MCP 短板，并希望借采用推动其改进。
items.excerpt: Earendil Engineering explains why Pi added the Model Context Protocol (MCP): current MCP is better, and Codemode makes its tools composable inside a JavaScript sandbox. The post still calls composition the central weakness, arguing that servers should expose structured data with intelligent tool discovery, closer to OpenAPI. Pi's newer model support also required deferred tools and Codemode-only configuration. The authors present adoption as a way to shape MCP for small harnesses while its servers and patterns continue to improve.

items.title: Ransomware Attack on Financial Lender Triggers Customer Lawsuit Within 48 Hours (2 minute read)
items.summary: The Gold Star Mortgage Financial Group is facing a lawsuit from customers after an alleged data breach by the BrainCipher ransomware group. The lawsuit alleges that the ransomware group stole more than 10k files from the mortgage lender, including full names, SSNs, residential addresses, and other contact information.
items.score_reason: 网络安全事件：勒索攻击后 48 小时内面临客户诉讼。
items.highlight: BrainCipher 勒索组织攻击抵押贷款机构 Gold Star Mortgage，窃取逾万份文件并加密数据库；借款人称社保号等敏感信息现身暗网，事发仅数日便提起诉讼，凸显金融机构数据保护与应急响应的迫切性。
items.excerpt: A ransomware attack targeting a financial services company has reportedly been followed by a lawsuit from one of its customers, who claims that her sensitive personal information was exposed and later appeared on the dark web. The incident highlights the growing cybersecurity risks faced by mortgage lenders and other financial institutions that store large volumes of sensitive customer data.

items.title: Microsoft to block Entra ID script injection attacks starting October (2 minute read)
items.summary: Starting in mid-October, Microsoft Entra ID will enforce a Content Security Policy that permits only Microsoft CDN-hosted scripts on browser sign-in pages at login.microsoftonline.com.
items.score_reason: 平台防护：微软将限制登录页的脚本来源。
items.highlight: 微软宣布自2026年10月中旬起在Entra ID登录中强制执行内容安全策略，只允许微软可信CDN脚本运行，以阻断跨站脚本等外部脚本注入；企业应提前停用向登录页注入代码的扩展与工具，并测试登录场景排查兼容问题。
items.excerpt: Microsoft has reminded customers that the Entra ID identity and access management (IAM) solution will get better protection against external script injection attacks starting next month.

items.title: The problem with wild code? IT can't see it coming (5 minute read)
items.summary: AI-assisted software development is making it easier for employees to build applications and automations outside traditional development processes. The bigger enterprise challenge may be visibility: knowing what has been built, what data it touches, who owns it, and whether security and lifecycle controls exist.
items.score_reason: 企业管理：影子开发的可见性与归属难题。
items.highlight: IBM调查显示77%组织认为AI采用已超出治理能力、70%称业务团队部署技术快于IT追踪；影子开发者用AI在财务、人事等部门构建的“野生代码”不进代码仓库、安全扫描无法覆盖，治理应从持续清点可见性入手。
items.excerpt: In Spring 2026, a software developer posted on Reddit about a backend system they were asked to audit. On paper, it looked clean: it passed every check. No injection vulnerabilities, no race conditions, solid test coverage. Roughly 60% of the code had been written with AI assistance.

items.title: Stop Chasing AI Speed, Fix the Rework First (9 minute read)
items.summary: Measuring AI success primarily through speed or hours saved can hide rework and poor outcomes. Focus on business results and explicitly define where AI assists, where human judgment remains necessary, and how employees participate in redesigning workflows.
items.score_reason: 管理观点：AI 成效衡量应转向业务结果。
items.highlight: Workday研究显示AI节省的时间约37%被返工吞掉，25-34岁员工承担最多校对；企业若只在旧岗位叠加工具，只会更疲惫，应把AI辅助与人类判断的边界写进岗位，并以成果而非省时衡量收益。
items.excerpt: Corporate executives speak frequently about entering a talent era dominated by durable human skills — empathy, critical judgment, and big-picture understanding. Yet, the operational reality shows a complete disconnect. Companies are still focusing on automating small, tedious tasks instead of changing how humans and AI work together to run the business as a whole. And there is a fundamental misunderstanding that when it comes to AI, speed = efficiency.

items.title: Introducing skills in the Gemini app and Workspace, plus what's next for Gems (5 minute read)
items.summary: Google is introducing reusable Gemini "skills" that can be combined inside prompts and shared across workflows, with Workspace rollout beginning October 5. Skills will eventually replace Gems, so Workspace admins should start planning for the transition and reviewing existing Gemini and Workspace Studio use cases.

items.highlight: 谷歌把可复用的自定义指令 skills 推向 Gemini 应用和 Workspace，将取代 Gems：Workspace 10 月 5 日起铺开，企业版 Gems 最早 2027 年 3 月停用并自动迁移为 skills。
items.excerpt: Gemini app and Google Workspace. Over the coming weeks, skills will roll out to Workspace users and eventually replace Gems as the tool for tailoring instructions for specific tasks.

items.title: Anthropic revelations suggest a much stronger AI negotiating stance for enterprise CIOs (5 minute read)
items.summary: Analyses of a confidential prospectus from Anthropic suggest that enterprise CIOs may hold a stronger negotiating position than previously assumed due to revenue concentration and a lack of long-term customer contracts. Vendors like Anthropic depend heavily on enterprise revenue, giving buyers leverage to negotiate price protections, data portability, and advance notice for model retirements. However, enterprises must also manage infrastructure dependencies and cost structures as frontier AI providers capture a dominant share of market revenue.
items.score_reason: 商业分析：企业采购方在合同结构中的议价空间。
items.highlight: 路透对 Anthropic 保密招股书的分析显示，其近四分之一收入来自两家客户、许多大客户未签长约，分析师认为这反而给了企业 CIO 更强议价空间：应争取价格保护、模型退役预告与数据可迁移性。
items.excerpt: The fact that almost one-fourth of Anthropic’s revenue last year came from just two customers, and that many of its largest customers have not signed long-term contracts, could translate into a much stronger negotiating position for enterprise CIOs.

items.title: Bolt acquires Dokai to bring enterprise workflow experience into its coding agents (4 minute read)

Dokai co-founder Gerry Fernando Patia and the Dokai team join Bolt.new's AI and machine learning organization, bringing production experience deploying autonomous agents inside enterprise systems.

items.highlight: 设计师 Marcin Wichary 分享在德国与波兰博物馆拍到的模块化工业仪表盘：慕尼黑德意志博物馆的空管显示、斯图加特的地铁监控面板、纽伦堡与华沙火车博物馆的同类系统，按钮与指示灯构成实体交互界面，如今大多已被软件取代。

items.title: Why State is the Hardest Thing in Software Design
items.summary: In this article, we will look at why state is the hardest thing in software development and the multiple strategies that developers can use to manage it.
items.score_reason: 系统设计文章：状态管理的难点与取舍策略。
items.highlight: 文章指出状态是软件设计中最难的部分：请求重叠、扩容、机器故障与部署都会挑战状态正确性；「让应用无状态」并非没有状态，而是让应用服务器易于替换、把关键状态外移，需厘清状态为何存在、由谁拥有、失效时会怎样。
items.excerpt: State is the information a system retains that affects its functionality in some way. For example, a website might keep track of users who have logged in. A document editor remembers the current text. A background worker logs which tasks it has completed and which ones are pending. A database stores the records written to it for as long as needed.

The new tool allows users to send prompts like “order my usual,” and the agent will understand that they mean their Friday night order.

items.title: Ideogram 4.5: The most precise edit model (2 minute read)
items.summary: Ideogram 4.5 is an exceptionally precise image editing model that can make targeted changes while preserving the rest of an image.
items.score_reason: 图像编辑模型更新：保持其余区域的精确局部编辑。
items.highlight: Ideogram 4.5 发布，主打多轮编辑一致性：减少像素漂移、颜色与纹理失真，官方对比称 GPT Image 2.5 与 Nano Banana 数轮后即不可用；支持原分辨率精修，保留裁切边缘便于无缝拼回原图。
items.excerpt: With each edit, image models can introduce pixel shifts, color changes, and texture artifacts. Ideogram 4.5 reduces this drift, preserving details across multi-turn edits.

items.title: NetApp ticks another hyperscaler box with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure deal (4 minute read)
items.summary: Oracle and NetApp are planning a fully managed, OCI-native storage service built around NetApp ONTAP. The offering is intended to let enterprises move databases, VMware, regulated workloads, and AI data into OCI while retaining familiar NetApp management and protection workflows.
items.score_reason: 企业存储合作：ONTAP 原生的 OCI 托管服务计划。
items.highlight: NetApp 与 Oracle 联合推出基于 OCI 的全托管存储服务，把 ONTAP 原生带到第四家超大规模云，客户可经 OCI 控制台与 API 管理，迁移无需改造应用，服务将在 12 个月内 GA。

items.title: A new transformer passes its hidden state to the next token instead of recomputing it (25 minute read)
items.summary: Researchers built LIFT, a transformer that feeds its internal state back into the next generation step instead of squeezing everything through the single token it outputs. Training stays parallel because the states come precomputed from an off-the-shelf model's next-token predictions, while at inference the model feeds back its own. LIFT models from 135M to 1B parameters beat token-matched standard transformers on language modeling, reasoning, and procedural tasks, so the next question is whether the gains hold at frontier scale.
items.score_reason: 架构研究：把隐藏状态直接传给下一生成步的新 Transformer 范式。

items.title: How I Could've Accessed 17 Trillion Microsoft Records (9 minute read)
items.summary: An internal Microsoft analytics service accepted unsigned JWTs, allowing a forged admin identity to run SQL across an environment estimated at 17.3 trillion stored rows. The bounded investigation exposed the consequences of skipping signature verification and showed how persistent agent exploration combined with a human insight to uncover the flaw.
items.score_reason: 安全调查：未签名 JWT 打通内部数据分析服务的完整复盘。
